itemContentReadParams.$comment: The server resolves itemId through the owning Thread navigation index, then reads public text only from the current path or the Thread-visible task mailbox. Tool and private reasoning content are never addressable.

message.description: Public display message; transport limits UTF-8 encoding to 512 bytes and rejects control characters. The fixed WORKSPACE_BUSY tuple may carry an owner-prefixed summary of existing thread display names; raw diagnostics are not public messages.
